name: chickenpick
description: ChickenPick: a playable chicken-pickin' Tele desk for your MIDI keyboard. Tempo-synced muted ghosts, open twang, double-stops and hybrid snaps over YOUR BPM/key/chords, with country bass + train-beat drums. DAW-grid WAV + MIDI export.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html app.js styles.css dist/
